about: What a generated infiltration level must satisfy when the constraint solver places it (T95): the three conditions draw-and-test already kept a level by, and two a designer wants that it could only hope for. Each variable -- a box, a lamp, a hiding place, a patrol's route point, the sentry's post -- may take one of `candidates` places drawn from the seed; the solver chooses among them. Distances are metres, steps walk cells, light 0 to 1.
constraints: the exit can be walked to from the start
every route point and post can be walked to from the start
no guard's post is in sight of the start
each patrol's route passes near a hiding place
a dark way leads from the start to the exit
